_doc: IBKR Pro tiered commission schedule. Each rule has a key matching the cost_model.py classification (asset_class, market). Values denominated in `currency`. Refresh from https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/pricing/commissions-home.php when the schedule changes.
_edit_authority: ⚑ THIS FILE IS READ-ONLY TO EVERY AGENT (hq CLAUDE.md convention 8). The
2026-08-12 edit to the three EU_STK_* min_per_order values was made by
Claude Code under Marcel's EXPLICIT per-edit authorisation, asked for and
given in session: 'EBS, yes, we have to use what is actually being
charged'. It is NOT a precedent and does not amend the convention, which
is his to amend (0b vii). Read the git history that way.
Why this one is admissible where a hand-edit would not be. S1-33 forbids
ASSUMED costs; these are MEASURED — 137 live European fills over two
sessions, every one with its exec_exchange and charged commission
recorded. asset_class_buckets.json's own note anticipated exactly this
edit when it said broker_ibkr.json was left untouched on 2026-08-11
because 'those are rates, and the live batch measures them'. The batch
has now measured them. Nothing here was chosen by anyone.
⚑ WHAT THE NEW VALUES ARE, AND ARE NOT. min_per_order now holds the
ROUTING-WEIGHTED charge per order across the venues SMART actually
reaches for that line — which is what a retail client pays in
expectation, and follows the same 'cost per user, not cost per venue'
call that made the European cells route SMART in the first place. It is
no longer the schedule minimum; that is kept beside it as
_min_per_order_schedule, and _min_per_order_measured_n carries the fill
count behind each.
⚑ VALID WHERE THE MINIMUM BINDS, UNKNOWN ABOVE IT. Every measurement is
at one share, so it cannot say whether a venue's excess over schedule
(EBS: CHF 3.58 against 1.50) is a flat per-order fee that persists at
size or a rate that the per_value_bps line already captures. Above
roughly CHF 3,215 of notional the 6 bps rate binds and this correction
stops applying — if the excess is flat, the model under-states there.
Settling it needs fills at a second notional. Not measured, not assumed.
⚑ THE ROUTING MIX IS AN OBSERVATION, NOT A CONSTANT. These weights are
SMART's behaviour on two days in August 2026. If IBKR changes its
routing the weights move and these numbers go stale silently, because
nothing re-derives them. Re-measure before treating them as current.

US_STK.notes: Tiered for monthly volume <300k shares; lower rates above. Pro tier; IBKR Lite is $0 commission but worse fills.

US_ETF.notes: Same schedule as US_STK on Pro tiered. Some ETFs are commission-free under IBKR Lite or specific programmes.

US_SMALL_CAP_STK.notes: Same Pro tiered schedule as US_STK. Separate key only so the calculator can apply small-cap-specific spread medians from the harness.

EU_STK_XETRA.notes: XETRA (DE). 5 bps, capped at €99. min_per_order is the ROUTING-WEIGHTED charge measured over 61 live SMART fills (2026-08-11/12), not the €1.25 schedule minimum: EUDARK/GETTEX2/TRWBEN charge €1.25 exactly, IBIS2 charges €1.3018.

EU_STK_LSE.notes: LSE main market (UK). 5 bps, capped at 1.49% of trade value. min_per_order is the ROUTING-WEIGHTED charge over 42 live SMART fills (2026-08-11/12), not the £1.00 schedule minimum: EUDARK/TRWBUKETF charge £1.00 exactly, LSEETF charges £1.16.

EU_STK_SIX.notes: SIX Swiss Exchange. 6 bps, capped at CHF 99. min_per_order is the ROUTING-WEIGHTED charge over 34 live SMART fills (2026-08-11/12), not the CHF 1.50 schedule minimum. EBS — the SIX primary — charges CHF 3.58, 2.39x the schedule, on 7 of 7 fills with zero variance; EUDARK/TRWBCH charge CHF 1.50 exactly and take 76% of the flow. This is the largest of the three corrections and the reason the set was made.

FX_IDEALPRO.notes: IDEALPRO spot FX. 0.20 bps of trade value with $2 minimum. Commission charged in account base currency.

CFD_FX.notes: Mirrors IDEALPRO pricing for forex CFDs.

CFD_INDEX.notes: Index CFDs. Schedule varies per region; check pricing page.

FUT_CME.notes: ES/NQ/RTY (e-mini index). Exchange fee bundled into commissionReport. Total typically ~$2.25/side.

FUT_NYBOT.notes: ICE US futures: DX (USD index), KC (coffee), CC (cocoa), CT (cotton), SB (sugar). Total ~$2.22/side.

FUT_EUREX.notes: FESX (Euro Stoxx 50), FDAX (DAX), etc. Refresh per-product fee from EUREX schedule.
